name: Mirror-Lake Onryo
loreTies: A grievance spirit reflected through Gate water, attacking broken promises with silence, drag, and cursed positioning.
Pulls the Deity toward hazards and slows recovery.
source culture humans later copied as Japanese myth and Shinto shrine lore
shortBackstory: Mirror-Lake Onryo is a lore-faithful Kami run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Mirror-Lake Onryo belongs to The Sacred Kingdoms and exists to express Kami law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Pulls the Deity toward hazards and slows recovery.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Pale mirror-water body, wet black hair veil, cracked moon reflection aura, shrine-rope wrists. Abilities — Grudge Pull, Reflection Hex, Drowned Silence — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.
